banned_primitives.name: raw useEffect
banned_primitives.remediation: Move the side effect into a declarative hook exported from src/core (e.g. useSubscription, useQuery) and call that instead.

banned_primitives.name: raw useLayoutEffect
banned_primitives.remediation: Move the layout side effect into a declarative API in src/core.

banned_primitives.name: raw setTimeout
banned_primitives.remediation: Do not use setTimeout for timing workarounds in ui/domain (RFC-001 §2.3). Encapsulate legitimate timers as a declarative API in src/core.
